description: Tasks. fetch.max_files: how many files one `task fetch` may copy. task_file_reminder: a prompt that wrote task files but not TASK.md is asked once, at Stop, to update it. review: a task with [review]=n may use n + extra_checks checks before a person must allow more; max_n caps the n a prompt can ask for. snapshots: how long the copies made at the gates are kept, and the largest file that is copied. report.copilot_events: the task report and the board read Copilot's own session record (~/.copilot/session-state/<session>/events.jsonl) for time and usage, numbers only; false: the hook log only, no usage. mapreduce: after the user typed /generic-mapreduce, the session may call the read-only mapper subagent max_agents times within that many minutes; 0 turns it off. autorun (beta): a task in autorun is pushed on to its next TODO step at most max_steps times within minutes; it stops when the gate refused max_denies calls, or after max_stalls pushes in a row with nothing moved. report.prompt_chars: how many characters of what the user typed the task page shows for each prompt (from Copilot's record; the page only, never given to an agent; a longer prompt is cut and ends in …, and the mouse over it shows all that is kept); 0: none. board: `task board --serve` serves the board on 127.0.0.1:port (a person starts it in a terminal; the browser is paired with a code that is never written down); closed_shown: how many of the newest closed tasks the board lists (the page filters and sorts them); actions are the buttons that act from the page; pause and resume need no pairing, the others ask for the paired browser and a typed code, as in the terminal. Can be added: `review extend`, `review waive`, `autorun on`. `recover` stays in the terminal.
